title: Process and Cost of Mediation for Accidents Involving Personal Mobility Devices
what_it_is: Process and Cost of Mediation for Accidents Involving Personal Mobility Devices

sections.label: Mediation charges for PMD cases
sections.summary: SMC and Law Society have received no PMD mediation cases; Law Society charges start at $350 per party, SMC at $107 per party.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To date, the SMC and Law Society have not received any mediation cases involving PMD users and their accident victims.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Law Society’s charges start from $350 per party.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: SMC’s charges start from $107 per party and vary according to the type of mediation and the dispute amount.

sections.label: PMD-sharing third-party liability insurance
sections.summary: LTA announced motorised PMD-sharing licensees must procure and maintain third-party liability insurance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: More recently, LTA also announced that motorised PMD-sharing licensees will be required to procure and maintain third-party liability insurance.

sections.label: Legal Aid income limit
sections.summary: Those earning more than $1,500 cannot get help from Legal Aid.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: If you earn more than $1,500, you cannot get help from Legal Aid already.

sections.label: Seeking compensation for PMD accidents
sections.summary: Victims may seek compensation via private settlement or mediation, and are encouraged to file a Police report if significantly injured.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Just to give a summary of how victims in PMD accidents can proceed to seek compensation, like I mentioned before, it could be in the form of either a private settlement or through mediation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: If the victim was involved in an accident and suffered significant injuries, he is encouraged to quickly file a Police report as that would allow the Police to launch an investigation to determine if an offence has been committed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And should the Attorney-General's Chambers assess that an offence had been committed, then the Court will consider whether to order the offender to compensate the victim.
